title: Blog and Publishing Platform
objective: Build a reviewable Django application that demonstrates Articles, categories, tags, comments, Author profiles and drafts, Publishing permissions.

milestones.title: Requirements and design
acceptance_criteria: Write the goal, data ownership rules, routes, and key assumptions.
Identify one failure/boundary case before coding.

milestones.title: Core models and workflows
acceptance_criteria: Implement a minimal vertical slice with models, views, templates/API and migrations as appropriate.
Keep business rules separate from display code and validate untrusted input.

milestones.title: Verification and access control
acceptance_criteria: Add positive, negative, validation, and permission tests.
Record expected versus observed results; do not claim unrun tests passed.

milestones.title: Maintainability and delivery notes
acceptance_criteria: Document setup, local reset instructions, dependencies and version assumptions.
Document security, backup/deployment limits and remaining work.

stretch_features: Add a documented performance measurement or appropriate database constraint.
Add an accessibility/usability check and a recovery path for expected failures.
Add structured logs/monitoring notes with sensitive values redacted.
test_plan: Test a normal workflow with synthetic data.
Test invalid/missing input and a denied/unauthorized request.
Test an edge or concurrency case relevant to the application.
Record Python/Django/database versions and exact commands run.

rubric.criterion: Design, data modeling and framework use

review_method: Human-reviewed local project with automated tests, documented evidence, and static validation. The CodeLeaf browser preview does not execute arbitrary Django/Python applications.
status_note: Adapted from Section D of the attached Django PDF. A reference outline is not a complete implementation; review the project, tests, and security boundaries before publication.
